Codex models

Meet the AI models that power ChatGPT Work and Codex. GPT-5.6, GPT-6, and GPT-6.1 remain available in Work and Codex. Current model IDs: gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna.

GPT-5.5 retired from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in on October 14, 2026.

gpt-5.3-codex-spark was retired from Codex on September 14, 2026 and is no longer available.

gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini retired from ChatGPT sign-in Codex on August 31, 2026.

gpt-5.2 and gpt-5.3-codex are deprecated without a retirement date.
